::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 25th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 75-76
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
Thanks, I should prefer having the [monthly sum](organizations/other_160.qmd) in cheques here, but the £200 to be paid to [Messrs Hoare](organizations/other_169.qmd). I hope the proofs are coming though it is rather late if the <u>[Dove](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd)</u> is to come out this [month](organizations/other_78.qmd). I am afraid there are some anachronisms in it, and I did not give it the looking over that I should have done if I had thought of not seeing it again.

Here are these two chapters of [Bethlehem](organizations/other_177.qmd), I would have sent Abraham, but I could not get him finished today. His chapter will be more descriptive. 

I think I must do the preparation through the Israelites <u>first</u> before that of the heathen world, because in point of time Israelite history comes before Gentile history. I thought of trying to give a highly drawn out picture of each stage of Jewish prophecy - the next after Abraham to be the death bed of Jacob.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
